capabilities: Update heading wikilinks, embeds and property links after you retype a heading
Show reference counts beside headings and block IDs
Update Markdown links and block ID links (Pro)
Preview and selectively apply link changes (Pro)
Report and fix broken heading and block links (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a file-syncing tool; 'sync' here means it updates links to a heading after you rename it.
extras: Freemium: core link updating and reference counts are free; Markdown links, block IDs, change preview and broken-link reports are Pro via a GitHub Sponsors payment with device-flow sign-in. The README details network behavior, token storage and offline limits. After minor or major updates it opens a What's new tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and a Telegram community.
intentEvidence: Core rename commands use a dialog. Retyped headings leave broken links.
problem: Obsidian's core rename commands use a dialog, and headings retyped directly in the editor leave behind broken heading links.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Rename-follower that updates wikilinks, embeds and property links to a heading when you retype its text in the editor, with optional Pro support for Markdown links and block IDs.
